proposals.evidence: DEDR561 gives Kannada ugur, Tulu uguru, Kodagu oy and Kurukh orᵒx finger-nail. Survey uguru/ugarɨ and glide variants are comparative regional matches, with initial v-/a- and medial-y notation preserved. Kurukh orox matches the corrected rhotic spelling; the primary explicitly rejects Grignard’s oṛᵒx, so survey retroflex-r forms are held separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2552 gives Tamil/Malayalam iravu, irā, rā night, Irula rāvu night, Malayalam iruṭṭu/iriṭṭu darkness, and Kannada iruḷ/iraḷu/iraṭu/irḷu night. The selected simple southern forms match the night/darkness family, including loss of initial i- and final-vowel variants. Darkness-form responses elicited as night retain that survey sense; compound rāpodu-type answers are handled separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

The simple Mannan moḷi and Irula muḷi elbow responses select the joint stem with the elicited anatomical specialization; no hand component is supplied where absent. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
